title: The Cordillera Blanca: glaciers, floods and an earthquake
goal: Talk about the glaciers of the Cordillera Blanca and the disasters of 1941 and 1970, putting one idea in the spotlight with cleft sentences.

items: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que..., Fue en... cuando...*).
I can say where the Cordillera Blanca is and why its glaciers matter.
I can use the new words for the mountains: *glaciar*, *laguna*, *aluvión*, *deshielo*.
